title: Classical finite dimensional fixed point methods for generalized functions
summary: We prove Banach, Newton-Raphson and Brouwer fixed point theorems in the framework of generalized smooth functions, a minimal extension of Colombeau's theory (and hence of classical distribution theory) which makes it possible to model nonlinear singular problems, while at the same time sharing a number of fundamental properties with ordinary smooth functions, such as the closure with respect to composition and several non trivial classical theorems of the calculus.
